args.text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

Hi Pree, I went through #central-team and found three Marrow Agrisupply sites:

1. *Eastbank*: Hollis, 9 Jun 2026, 10:46 AM. Ticket PD-4821 has Eastbank's receiving-door import attached. The file labels doors E1/E2 but the booking sheet uses 01/02, so that mismatch needs fixing before anyone reimports, or it'll create duplicates.
2. *Pine Crossing*: you, 9 Jun 2026, 10:48 AM. The morning receiver only sees the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver who arrived at 7:10 got logged on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and have support reproduce it with the store login.
3. *Wichita store*: you, 2 Jul 2025, 9:21 AM. You mentioned an 8am check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher on the Marrow Agrisupply office hours Zoom link. I'm inferring this is a Marrow site because of that context; the message doesn't name the account outright.

Two other notes:
• Hollis's 9 Jun escalation says the new stores are rolling out slowly and that three rows on the tracker just say "waiting." Those stores aren't named anywhere in the channel, so there may be more sites than these three.
• The Tulsa hub in the same 2025 thread belongs to Tansley Parcel, not Marrow, so I left it out.
